description: Land Acquisition - Nedolakanda, Kolonna D/S Division,  Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters, specifically declaring that certain lands are required for public purpose under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots (including boundaries, extents, and locations) but does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister is incidental to the land acquisition declaration process.
